whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Gold’s Gym,

I noticed your Boring Road branch has strong 4.2★ reviews with 1,800+ local members, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for instant membership inquiries and batch schedules.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, workout programs, aur batch timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://goldsgymboring.arclanestudios.space

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Gold’s Gym team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke Boring Road branch ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your members in Boring Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
